candidates.name: contempt under R.C. 2705.02
candidates.grading: Contempt sanctions, not an ordinary felony/misdemeanor grade: first offense up to $250 and/or 30 days; second up to $500 and/or 60 days; third or subsequent up to $1,000 and/or 90 days.
evidenceQuotes: [2705.02] A person guilty of any of the following acts may be punished as for a contempt:
[2705.02] (A) Disobedience of, or resistance to, a lawful writ, process, order, rule, judgment, or command of a court or officer;
[2705.05] (A) In all contempt proceedings, the court shall conduct a hearing.
[2705.05] (1) For a first offense, a fine of not more than two hundred fifty dollars, a definite term of imprisonment of not more than thirty days in jail, or both;
[2705.05] (3) For a third or subsequent offense, a fine of not more than one thousand dollars, a definite term of imprisonment of not more than ninety days in jail, or both.

resolution: Treat as a contempt charge with the special 2705.05 sanction ladder, not as a conventional criminal degree.

resolution: Nine distinct statutory names. Marihuana trafficking is not universal: Chapter 3796 authorizes qualifying nonremunerated adult transfers and licensed cultivation, processing, transfer, and sales. For example, 3796.18 states: “a licensed cultivator ... may ... Deliver, transfer, or sell medical marijuana and adult-use marijuana to other license holders”; 3796.20 authorizes a licensed dispensary to “Dispense or sell adult-use marijuana in accordance with division (C) of this section.”
